links.outcome: Performance of RAG-grounded specialized model versus generalist LLMs on pediatric nephrology cases
links.effect: Domain-specific fine-tuning with retrieval-augmented generation on validated materials improved performance across all clinical criteria without enhancing reasoning capabilities.
links.quote: Domain-specific fine-tuning improved performance across all clinical criteria without enhancing reasoning capabilities.

screen.reason: The study evaluates LLM performance on pediatric nephrology clinical cases and specifically evaluates the impact of adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) using validated pediatric nephrology materials compared to baseline models.
